items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026, Monday (DeSantis press conference; exact time not stated)
items.title: DeSantis Monday briefing: ~400 FL State Guard soldiers deployed for Isaias recovery; $10M zero-interest business loans; Walmart $1M
items.summary: Gov. DeSantis' Monday press conference: Florida State Guard deployed nearly 400 soldiers (1,700 miles of roadway cleared; 4,000 cases of water, 1,700 meals, 2,600 bags of ice, 2,200 tarps distributed; 20+ flight hours on search/rescue and damage assessment). FloridaCommerce made $10M available in short-term, zero-interest loans for impacted businesses; Walmart committed $1M in funding and supplies for Panhandle recovery; the state insurance assistance hub opened Monday. DeSantis said 'more than 70% of the accounts have been restored' and that 'probably about 500,000' accounts lost power at one point or another.

items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026, Monday (announced; exact time not stated)
items.title: Mexico's Navy (Semar) closed Pacific ports across Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco and Michoacan to navigation ahead of Simon
items.summary: Semar announced preventive navigation closures Monday ahead of Cat-2 Simon's Wednesday-Thursday approach to Mexico's west-central coast. Minor vessels: Topolobampo and Teacapan (Sinaloa); San Blas, La Cruz de Huanacaxtle, Nuevo Vallarta, Chacala (Nayarit); Puerto Vallarta and Barra de Navidad (Jalisco); Lazaro Cardenas (Michoacan). Major vessels: San Blas (Nayarit) and Puerto Vallarta (Jalisco). Sinaloa port closures are new (PVR/Manzanillo were already shut Sunday). Conagua flagged high surf, landslide, river-overflow and flooding risk across the watch zone.
